'''Lifting claws''' were a type of device used to move cargo within buildings. They were often employed in [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]], and could be used to store various [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Some were mounted on rails in the ceiling, while other lifting claws were fixed in place.<ref name="MOTS" />

By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] held [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] in-air at their [[Altyr V base|base]] on the planet [[Altyr V]]. [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Pirate king]] [[Kaerobani]] deployed lifting claws in both his [[Kaerobani's base|base]] on and his [[Orbiting Ship Yards]] above [[Rathalay]], an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean-covered]] planet.<ref name="MOTS" /> Smaller versions were installed on [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation's]] [[Mark VI Powersuit]],<ref name="EJ">{{WEGCite|story=The Evacuation of Jatee|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref> [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]]'s [[DC5-1]] [[Loader droid/Legends|freight droid]],<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[LesTech]]'s [[Horse/Legends|horse-like]] droid [[PackTrack 41LT-R]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
